generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A UI can preserve nominal structure while translating unavailable required data into valid-looking values or rendering monetary numbers without their unit.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Use convenient empty or zero fallbacks for failed required resources and verify currency only on components already using a money primitive.
trigger_signals: required remote resource influences financial state
numeric monetary text exists outside a money primitive
negative control only inspects happy-path selectors
generalized_learning.reusable_control: For each required financial resource, inject failure and require an explicit error state; scan every numeric monetary label for an explicit unit or a deliberate unavailable state.
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Required financial inputs fail closed before semantic composition, and numeric monetary output may be emitted only when its currency or unit is available.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Negative tests must attack nested resource failures and raw monetary labels outside canonical money components.

transfer_cases.evidence: Synthetic purchase and summary failures are rejected as error states rather than empty values.
Synthetic instrument limits require an ISO currency or render no numeric amount.

skill_changes.evidence: The promoted prevention rule is represented in the current attack matrix and inherited controls.
The promoted detection rule is represented in focused negative controls for nested failures and raw limit labels.
